programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon casse le minuteur de maman et tente de remplacer l'œuf Mimosa de Cunégonde, déclenchant une drôle de chasse au trésor. Ensuite, sa musique dérange les puces, qui finissent par partir. Bagou s'amuse avec un sifflet à ultrasons qui rend fou, avant qu'un accident ne le transforme en ange pacifique. Enfin, Pétunia sauve tout le monde d'une inondation avec un bateau gonflable.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon casse le miroir de Pétunia, qui lui prédit 7 ans de malheur. Malchance et catastrophes s'enchaînent, mais ce n'est qu'une superstition. Puis, lors d'un goûter les assiettes s'envolent à cause du vent et un pigeon s'en sert comme planche de surf. Enfin, Grabouillon évite le dessert en fuyant et doit ranger la chambre. Dernier défi : remettre une pendule tombée avant l'arrivée de maman.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Après une blague ratée, Bagou et Grabouillon sont poursuivis par des abeilles et se réfugient dans la serre de Basile. Pendant une partie de croquet, Grabouillon résout un Rubik's Cube mais doit recommencer avec l'aide de Bagou. Grabouillon évite le bain en se parfumant, ce qui dérange les Pucekipic. Enfin, la taupe, triste, surprend tout le monde en gagnant aux jeux, semant la frustration.

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: Pris pour un gibier par Davy Crockett, Coda se retrouve soldat au fort ! À Versailles, présenté comme un exotique, il s'évade et découvre la vie de cour. Son hologramme guide malgré lui une bergère contre les Anglais. En Écosse, après avoir brillé aux Highland Games, Coda fait exploser un pub… et réveille un fantôme très fâché !

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: Dinosaures, météorites, australopithèques, tigres à dents de sabre, découverte du feu, usine du XXe siècle, pollution, Charlot, sorcière et bossu de Notre-Dame… Coda traverse les âges et sème un joyeux chaos. Et si derrière chaque grand événement de l'Histoire se cachait un petit extraterrestre un peu trop curieux ?

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: Coda traverse les âges : il pourchasse Pégase en Grèce antique, aide Thésée à vaincre le Minotaure, tombe sous le charme de sirènes, apprend aux hommes des cavernes le feu et l'art rupestre, invente les hiéroglyphes en Égypte et inspire la légende de Moïse. Même chez les Indiens d'Amérique, sa danse de la pluie vire au désastre. Un alien perdu, mais plein d'impact !

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: De pirate à roi Arthur, de Chicago à la banquise, Coda vit mille vies ! Il sauve un marin, enflamme un pirate, arrache Excalibur avant de suivre Arthur à Camelot, croise Al Capone en quête d'alcool pour sa soucoupe, et finit avalé par une baleine en Arctique. Rien ne l'arrête… sauf peut-être la malchance. Survivra-t-il à ce voyage à travers les âges ?

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: RNS a un hoquet... mais il n'a peur de rien. Comment faire pour lui faire passer ?Les jeux électroniques ça rend zinzin !

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Lulu donne des conseils à RNS pour qu'il fasse des progrès en ski. Il devient aussi bon... voire meilleur qu'elle... Lulu n'apprécie pas.RNS se fait passer pour éclopé pour se soustraire à la corvée labourage du potager. Mais Lulu et les copains lui font croire qu'un trésor est enfoui sous la terre qu'ils sont en train de retourner...

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Blaise, délaissé par Frou-Frou, fait croire qu'il est blessé pour attirer l'attention. Mais son rôle de « grand blessé » l'isole vite. Comment réparer ça ? Pendant ce temps, la bande demande à Frou-Frou de les aider à faire une carte, mais la chouette, distraite, se cogne et craint de voler.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: La maîtresse montre à Lulu une sculpture faite d'objets assemblés et propose de créer une œuvre collective. Les idées fusent, entre sérieux et absurdité, jusqu'à ce que Lulu trouve l'inspiration. Pendant ce temps, les amis cherchent un cadeau pour Brico, qui préfère réparer son coucou suisse tranquillement.

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Sortis de la warpzone, Marcus et ses amis sont enchaînés par Vipkrad, forcés de rester proches malgré l'indépendance que réclame Marcus. Leur obsession devient de briser ces chaînes. Puis, ils doivent affronter Vipkrad dans une course piégée, mais la malchance, que Marcus croit subir, se révèle contagieuse !

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Le roi des Moonsliders offre un fragment de miroir au vainqueur du concours de danse. Marcus, trac au rendez-vous, affronte Vipkrad et ses robots. Puis, pour conquérir la princesse Youpla et son fragment, Marcus est tétanisé, incapable d'agir. Gratrok prend sa place, mais sans être impressionné par Youpla… Marcus doute alors de son allié.

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: La Tortue roule mal, et un matin ses freins sont coupés ! Qui est responsable ? Sherlock a un accident avec la voiture de Hermine, la fait réparer, et lui cache la vérité. Le Zèbre se réveille avec un dessin écossais : vengeance ou jalousie ? Okapi, couleuvre ou tigre ? Hermine doute de ses capacités de détective, Sherlock la soutient.

programme.title: Recherche Téléspectateurs
programme.desc: Carly et Sam se battent contre Freddie et Spencer pour décider de qui aura le meilleur plan pour rameuter les foules sur iCarly. La situation dégénère quand tous leur plans tournent à la catastrophe.

programme.title: Nevelocity
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie veulent qu'une critique de leur émission soit faite sur "Nevelocity", un site très populaire qui poste des critiques sur d'autres sites et émissions en ligne.

programme.title: Carly veut rester avec Spencer
programme.desc: Le grand-père de Carly et Spencer leur fait une visite surprise. Il est préoccupé par le fait que Spencer soit trop irresponsable et fainéant pour être le tuteur de Carly.

programme.title: Espionnage
programme.desc: Carly décide de faire une émission montrant ce que font les méchants profs quand ils ne sont pas à l'école. Elle décide de suivre son prof principal, Miss Briggs, mais se retrouve piégée avec Freddie dans l'appartement de Miss Briggs.

programme.title: Champion du monde
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie essayent de battre le record du monde de l'émission du web la plus longue. Pour ce faire, iCarly doit durer plus de 24h d'affilée...

programme.title: Freddie a une copine
programme.desc: Une fan d'iCarly, Valerie, demande à Freddie de sortir avec elle. Leur relation se passe si bien que Freddie commence à filmer la propre émission de Valerie.

programme.title: Naissance dun artiste
programme.desc: Carly invite l'idole de Spencer, Harry Joyner, pour qu'il puisse admirer son œuvre. Quand Harry qualifie son travail d'amateur, Spencer a le sentiment que sa vie n'avait plus de but.

programme.title: La plus grande des fans
programme.desc: La plus grande fan d'iCarly, Mandy, est invitée sur le plateau de l'émission comme seul public. Mandy s'avèrera être plus une traqueuse qu'une fan, et les enfants vont vite vouloir s'en débarrasser...

programme.title: Poussins.com
programme.desc: Carly et Sam cherchent à féconder des poules pour leur projet de sciences. Mais les poules s'échappent de l'incubateur...

programme.title: Je ne veux pas dembrouilles
programme.desc: Carly fabrique pour Sam un unique T-shirt iCarly pour commémorer l'anniversaire de leur amitié. Mais quand Sam échange le t-shirt contre des billets de concert, les deux amies se disputent.

programme.title: On peut toujours rêver
programme.desc: iCarly demande à ses fans d'envoyer des vidéos d'eux-mêmes pratiquant leur plus belle danse. Carly, Sam et Freddie recoivent plus de 3000 vidéos et se retrouvent à veiller toute la nuit pour les regarder.

programme.title: Joyeux Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie tournent iCarly dans un appartement prétendument hanté. Quand des choses étranges se mettent à se passer, les amis se demandent si les rumeurs de fantômes ne sont pas fondées...

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Spencer sauve la vie du chanteur de The Plain White T's et le convainc de participer à iCarly. Mais des choses étranges se mettent à arriver sur le plateau et l'on se rend vite compte que c'est Nevel qui essaye de saboter iCarly...

programme.title: Jai été collée
programme.desc: Sam est punie la nuit de la cinquantième émission d'iCarly. Inapte à faire l'enregistrement, Carly et Freddie font leur possible pour être punis à leur tour afin de diffuser l'émission durant la nuit, avec Sam.

programme.title: Mauvaise promotion
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie sont invités au QG de la marque de chaussures Daka, où on leur offre une belle somme d'argent pour essayer les nouvelles chaussures Daka, "Tech-foot", sur iCarly..

programme.title: Le dîner des vampires
programme.desc: Dans une paisible ferme à la campagne, les vampires de Grande-Bretagne se réunissent pour leur rencontre qui n'a lieu qu'une fois tous les cinquante ans. D'autres vont aussi les rejoindre : Sebastian Crockett, un jeune homme d'Essex naïf qui pense avoir rendez-vous avec la séduisante Vanessa, et un détachement de forces spéciales chasseurs de vampires qui vont se retrouver dépassés par la situation. Cette nuit promet d'être inoubliable… et pour certains, ce sera la dernière.

programme.title: It Came from the Desert
programme.desc: Les fourmis sont les véritables vedettes de ce buddy-movie qui rend un hommage direct aux films de monstres des années 50. Inspiré du cultissime jeu vidéo des années 80 It came from the desert ce film déjanté est un fabuleux mélange de fourmis géantes et de courses de moto dans le désert… Nouveau Mexique - Se rendant à une Keg Party où la bière coule à flots nos 2 coureurs de motocross vont faire une rencontre inattendue en tombant par hasard sur un ancien site militaire. Des expérimentations secrètes visant à croiser leur l'ADN avec des débris d'une métérorite trouvée en 1951 ont été menées sur des fourmis et araignées….et qui ont donné naissance à des fourmis géantes mutantes !

programme.title: Mémoires diaboliques
programme.desc: Lea, une femme napolitaine d'âge mûr vivant dans une ville du nord du pays, a eu treize enfants, tous morts à l'exception de Michele pour qui elle a une affection morbide, convaincue qu'elle l'a volé à la mort.

programme.title: Terreur sur l'asphalte
programme.desc: Une série de meurtres mystérieux a eu lieu à Montevideo, une petite ville en Californie. La femme d'un policier s'enfuit de son mari, cherchant à divorcer. Le policier tente de se réconcilier et commence à la suivre...

programme.title: Rufus et le Royaume d'Alyne
programme.desc: Des amis de toujours, Scott et Emily, sont chez la grand-mère de Scott lorsqu'ils découvrent, dans une pièce secrète, une mystérieuse créature nommée Rufus accompagnée du sorcier Abbot. Ils ont pour mission de sauver leur monde magique.

programme.title: Archie 2: Chien Robot
programme.desc: ARCHIE, le chien robot le plus intelligent de l'univers, se lie d'amitié avec Gregory, un petit garçon dont le père travaille dans un cirque itinérant au bord de la faillite. Il soupçonne un des employés du cirque de son père de voler les recettes du spectacle.

programme.title: Bobby et les Chasseurs de fantômes
programme.desc: Sanne, 13 ans, raffole des histoires fantastiques que lui raconte son père, Lucas, un chasseur de spectres très réputé.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: Un malin renard utilise son ingéniosité pour tirer profit de trois fermiers faibles d'esprit qui se résolvent à utiliser des tactiques extrêmes pour protéger leurs poulets...

programme.title: Foxter & Max
programme.desc: Un pré-adolescent artistique et frustré découvre que le chien graffiti qu'il a peint avec une boîte trouvée de ce qu'il pensait être de la peinture en aérosol, a pris vie sous la forme d'un super-chien ultra-intelligent fait de nanobots.

programme.title: The Last Champion
programme.desc: Un ancien lutteur de championnat est contraint de faire face à son passé lorsqu'il retourne dans la ville natale qu'il a quittée en disgrâce vingt ans plus tôt. Peut-il devenir le héros que sa ville attendait ou restera-t-il prisonnier de ses erreurs passées ?

programme.title: Shadow Master
programme.desc: Un justicier reçoit la mission de combattre un groupe de démons, les Cavaliers de l'Apocalypse, qui veulent enlever de jeunes enfants pour répandre le Mal sur terre et faire advenir la fin des Temps.

programme.title: Undercover Punch and Gun
programme.desc: Wu, policier infiltré au sein d'un réseau de méthamphétamine, doit s'associer à une bande hétéroclite pour faire tomber un énorme trafic de drogue.

programme.title: Night Shift
programme.desc: Une nuit explosive durant laquelle un vétéran chevronné de la police de Los Angeles emmène un jeune bleu en patrouille et lui montre la brutale réalité de leur métier...

programme.title: Chantou
programme.desc: Chantou, 45 ans, représentante en matelas bio et fumeuse impénitente, enceinte et étourdie, se retrouve le temps d'une soirée dans la ville de province où vit Yves, son fils aîné avec qui elle est brouillée. S'étant fait voler sa camionnette, Chantou compte bien se faire héberger chez lui et lui annoncer sa grossesse. Mais les retrouvailles ne se passent pas comme prévues. Seule dans une ville inconnue, commence alors pour Chantou un itinéraire nocturne qui va la chambouler.

programme.title: Without Sugar
programme.desc: Une journée à New York avec Sophie, une française, américaine d'adoption. Son regard sur la vie, la gourmandise, la tentation et les restrictions alimentaires…

programme.title: People are strange
programme.desc: Julien se considère comme le sosie légitime de Jim Morrison. Il gagne sa vie au cimetière du Père Lachaise en distrayant les touristes venus voir la tombe de la rockstar. Le jour où il apprend que la dépouille de son idole va être rapatriée en Californie, Julien entrprend de voler avec son ami Aldo les restes du Lizard King.

programme.title: Chasse royale
programme.desc: Angélique, treize ans, vient d'une famille nombreuse de la banlieue de Valenciennes. Ce jour-là dans son collège, on lui propose de passer un casting.

programme.title: Le bleu blanc rouge de mes cheveux
programme.desc: À dix-sept ans, Seyna, une adolescente d'origine camerounaise se passionne pour l'histoire de la France, le pays qui l'a vue naître. Son baccalauréat en poche et sa majorité approchant, Seyna n'aspire qu'à une chose : acquérir la nationalité française. Mais son père s'y oppose farouchement.

programme.title: Paroles, paroles
programme.desc: Dans les années 20, un couple embarque dans une nacelle afin de faire un tour en ballon. Le voyage ne se passe pas exactement comme prévu...

programme.title: La vita nuova
programme.desc: Un poète est à son écritoire quand un cocher frappe à sa fenêtre et l'invite à le suivre. Par la porte vitrée de la calèche défilent ses souvenirs... l'opéra, une diva merveilleuse... Il est temps pour le poète d'écrire son dernier vers. La Vita Nuova est un palimpseste cinématographique, directement inspiré de l'œuvre de Gérard de Nerval. D'après les poèmes de Gérard de Nerval

programme.title: Jeunesses françaises
programme.desc: Des lycéens passent un entretien avec un conseiller d'orientation plutôt malveillant. Comment les adolescents répondent à cette agression ? Entre fiction et documentaire, une série de portraits.

programme.title: Finistère
programme.desc: Salim a 21 ans et rêve de quitter sa banlieue natale de Dugny pour les plages de Bretagne. Sur la route, il fait la rencontre d'une mystérieuse jeune fille, Anouk, cleptomane qui va l'initier aux merveilles locales : Concarneau, la mer et surtout les bateaux.

programme.title: Un plan d'enfer
programme.desc: Deux cambrioleurs affolent les chiens d'un quartier en lâchant des dizaines de chats. Ils profitent du vacarme pour récupérer un magot. Mais un effet boule de neige se déclenche. Les voleurs vont vivre la nuit la plus éprouvante de leur vie.

programme.title: Gamin
programme.desc: Un gamin, Paulo, bricole sa voiture, une Peugeot 205 toit ouvrant, aidé par ses potes, pour aller retrouver son père, un père pas vu, plus vu depuis des années. Un père qu'il n'en peut plus d'espérer.

programme.title: Jamais Jamais
programme.desc: Week-end de Pâques, dans une ville de province. De permanence au commissariat, les lieutenants Françoise Ruiz et Clémentine Arpinon règlent les affaires courantes. L'ennui, de circonstance, éveille chez ces deux femmes que tout oppose une certaine envie d'en découdre. Une intervention pour tapage nocturne leur offre l'occasion de passer à l'acte.

programme.title: Fille du calvaire
programme.desc: Jérôme est tombé amoureux d'une jeune femme qu'il essaie de séduire. Jour après jour, il raconte l'évolution des opérations à son ami Patrick qui dispense ses conseils et vit par procuration les aventures de son cadet.

programme.title: Règlement de Conte
programme.desc: Mona et Hassan sont frère et soeur par alliance et ne s'entendent pas du tout. Ils sont envoyés dans un camp dirigé par le professeur de théâtre Melle Sankaré. Des les premières répétitions, une bagarre éclate entre eux. Punis, ils sont oubliés dans la foret. A leur réveil, ils ont changé de corps.

programme.title: Quelque chose brûle
programme.desc: Margot a des souvenirs, des idées noires qui la hantent et la mènent dans les montagnes de son enfance, chez son frère Adrien. Dans le froid de l'hiver le fantôme d'un frère disparu resurgit.

programme.title: La Plongeuse
programme.desc: Une plongeuse professionnelle s'entraîne intensément sous les coups de sifflets de son entraîneur. Epuisée, elle refuse de plonger une nouvelle fois et décide d'aller voir un masseur.

programme.title: De haute naissance
programme.desc: Le 12 juillet 1884, dans la demeure Modigliani, Garsin, un huissier et quatre policiers sont chargés de saisir tous les biens de la famille.

programme.title: Immobiles
programme.desc: “J'ai demandé à des gens que je ne connaissais pas, de poser totalement immobiles et de fixer l'objectif”. Des premiers clichés d'être humain au dispositif cinématographique, le film décline l'idée du portrait, à la fois arrêt du temps, représentation du vivant mais aussi expérience de la mort.

programme.title: La canne
programme.desc: Dans une salle de classe, les enfants attendent l'arrivée de leur nouvelle institutrice.

programme.title: Heurts
programme.desc: Fred, trente cinq ans, et Lisa, quarante cinq ans, s'aiment et essaient désespérément de faire un enfant. Mais en ce jour où Lisa fête son anniversaire et accuse la différence d'âge entre elle et Fred, celui-ci s'échappe pour une raison inconnue. Restée seule, Lisa va se laisser entraîner dans le tourbillon de son passé, et provoquer des heurts irrémédiables...

programme.title: PARADOX
programme.desc: Le négociateur de la police de Hong Kong, Lee Chung-Chi, apprend que sa fille de 16 ans, Wing-Chi, a disparu en Thaïlande. Il se rend sur place et fait équipe avec l'officier chinois Tsui Kit et son partenaire Tak pour affronter Sacha, un gangster américain à la tête d'un réseau de trafic d'organes. Une série d'indices conduit Chung-Chi à découvrir le sort de sa fille et à tout risquer pour démanteler le réseau une bonne fois pour toutes.

programme.title: The Agent
programme.desc: Jong-seong, un agent fantôme nord-coréen, interrompt une vente d'armes illégale à Berlin. Un agent nord-coréen notoire met à l'épreuve la loyauté de tous les participants alors que Jong-seong se prépare à faire le sacrifice ultime.

programme.title: Awaken
programme.desc: Un groupe de personnes se réveille sur une île où elles sont pourchassées.

programme.title: Midnight Heat
programme.desc: John Gray, un banquier aux manières douces, est renversé par une voiture et perd la plupart de ses souvenirs. Lorsqu'il sort de l'hôpital, il a des flashbacks qui ne cadrent pas avec sa vie actuelle. Après un appel téléphonique étrange et une tentative d'assassinat de sa femme, Gray est assassiné. Il est contraint de se rendre à Los Angeles afin de résoudre le crime et de reconstituer son mystérieux passé.

programme.title: Le Majordome
programme.desc: Léopold, valet de chambre d'un vieil avocat en fin de carrière, mène une double vie. Grâce à sa connaissance du code pénal, il est un «juge» très apprécié et respecté de la pègre parisienne. Le docteur Ventoux, alias «le Chat», un cambrioleur célèbre pour son agilité, sollicite sa collaboration pour un gros coup. Léopold, qui bénéficie d'une solide expérience dans les commandos, accepte et recrute une petite équipe qu'il soumet à un dur entraînement. Au cours d'une soirée donnée par le procureur, il fait la connaissance d'Agnès, la fiancée de Ventoux, et s'en éprend. Afin d'arracher la jeune femme au «Chat», il décide de saboter le hold-up...

programme.title: Un Été D'enfer
programme.desc: Elisabeth est à la recherche de sa soeur Valérie, disparue mystérieusement trois mois auparavant. Trouvant les hommes du commissaire Turielle trop lents dans leur enquête, elle engage un détective privé, Philippe Darland. L'enquête de celui-ci l'entraîne rapidement dans les milieux de la drogue où il découvre que le grand patron du réseau n'est autre que le commissaire Turielle.

programme.title: Sept Morts Sur Ordonnance
programme.desc: A dix ans d'intervalle, dans une petite ville de province, le Dr Losseray, excellent chirurgien d'origine modeste, connaît le même destin tragique que son confrère, le Dr Berg. Parce que tous deux ont refusé de faire alliance avec le clan médical dirigé par le professeur Brézé, ils sont acculés au suicide après avoir massacré leurs familles. Les Brézé peuvent ainsi conserver leur monopole en toute honorabilité.

programme.title: Point De Chute
programme.desc: Trois voyous enlèvent une jeune fille de quinze ans, Patricia, pour obtenir de son père le versement d'une rançon. Ils la séquestrent dans une cabane perdue au bord de la mer et la battent. Seul Eddie, un jeune voyou, gardien de la jeune fille, s'insurge contre ces méthodes. A travers un fait divers tragique, le portrait de deux adolescents dans un climat d'angoisse et de violence.

programme.title: Sahara (2005)
programme.desc: Pour Dirk Pitt, explorateur, scientifique et aventurier, découvrir cette pièce de légende n'était que le premier pas vers l'aventure la plus risquée de sa vie et une incroyable légende historique...

programme.title: Amour & Amnésie
programme.desc: Un homme tombe amoureux d'une femme qui souffre de graves troubles de la mémoire à court terme.

programme.title: Ainsi va la vie

programme.title: Stay

programme.title: Siberia

programme.title: Le Secret: Oser le rêve

Une puissante tempête amène dans sa vie un terrible défi et un homme mystérieux, Bray Johnson (Josh Lucas). En quelques jours seulement, la présence de Bray ravive l'esprit de la famille, mais il porte un secret qui pourrait tout faire basculer.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing

programme.title: Une femme de cran
programme.desc: Alyssa Milano est Patty Montanari, veuve et mère de famille déterminée vivant à Brooklyn. Elle trouve du travail auprès d'une famille de la mafia locale et tombe bientôt amoureuse d'un homme marié et ponte de la mafia (Jason Gedrick de DESPERATE HOUSEWIVES).

programme.title: Hurricane Season
programme.desc: À la suite de l'ouragan Katrina, l'entraîneur de basket-ball du lycée, Al Collins, rassemble des élèves de cinq écoles différentes de Louisiane et les mène jusqu'aux championnats de l'État.

programme.title: Sex Therapy

programme.title: Red Sky
programme.desc: Un pilote de chasse disgracié dirige une escouade dans la récupération d'une ADM cataclysmique.

programme.desc: Trois amies croquent la vie à pleines dents et n'ont pas besoin d'hommes pour être heureuses. Jusqu'au jour où l'une d'entre elles tombe amoureuse... Christina s'est toujours efforcée de respecter une règle d'or en matière de mecs: "Eviter toute relation sérieuse avec le sexe opposé".

programme.title: Divorce et je te tuerai
programme.desc: Lorsque son ex-mari revient dans sa vie, Josie se retrouve mêlée à un divorce compliqué avec son ex-épouse actuelle, Laura, qui semble déterminée à faire de la vie un enfer pour elle et tous ceux qui l'entourent.

programme.title: L'homme de ma vie et moi
programme.desc: Niki anime un podcast bien connu sur les relations amoureuses. Lorsqu'un grand éditeur la contacte pour un éventuel contrat de livre, elle se retrouve en difficulté car le podcast est basé sur sa relation avec un petit ami imaginaire, Monsieur Parfait. Elle a besoin d'un remplaçant...

programme.title: Le Café de l'Amour
programme.desc: La propriétaire d'un café où tout le monde tombe amoureux risque de tout perdre lorsqu'une célébrité fait sa demande en mariage et se fait larguer. Elle décide alors de tout faire pour réconcilier le couple.

programme.title: Un Anglais à New York
programme.desc: Sidney Young est un intellectuel désabusé qui adore autant qu'il méprise le monde des célébrités, de la gloire et du glamour. Son magazine alternatif, Post Modern Review , se moque des stars obsédées par les médias et va à contre-courant des tendances. Lorsqu'on lui propose un poste dans le très conservateur magazine new-yorkais Sharps , c'est un véritable choc ! Il semble que Clayton Harding, le rédacteur en chef de Sharps , ait été amusé par la perturbation d'une soirée post-BAFTA par Young, accompagné d'un cochon déguisé en Babe. Commence alors la descente de Sidney vers le succès : il passe progressivement du statut d'outsider moqué à celui de confident de la starlette Sophie Maes. Au début, il est aidé chez Sharps par sa collègue Alison Olsen, qui cache elle aussi un secret. Leur amitié y survivra-t-elle ?

Mais Annie rêve toujours de rencontrer ses vrais parents, disparus dans un incendie des années plus tôt et dont elle ignore le décès. Ce qui va inciter un couple de truands, Rooster et Lily, appâtés par une promesse de récompense et encouragés par Miss Hannigan, la sœur de Rooster, à se faire passer pour les parents de la petite.

Mais pour eux, aucun homme n'est assez bien pour leur mère, et ils sont capables de tout.

Mais elle découvre que ce club a évolué pour le pire sous la férule de la narcissique et cruelle Rachel. Dégoûtée de cet avilissement elle quitte la fraternité, mais se retrouve du même coup à la rue. Elle trouve alors refuge dans la maison d'un groupe de septs exclus de sa faculté, avec lesquels elle va ourdir un plan pour briser la mainmise de Rachel sur le campus et redonner leur dignité aux laissés-pour-compte du campus. Une version moderne et décalée de Blanche-Neige et les sept nains.

programme.title: Pensacola Wings of God
programme.desc: Dissous par le gouvernement, les Sea Dragons sont rappelés pour former de jeunes pilotes de chasse au combat aérien.

programme.title: Pensacola Wings of God
programme.desc: Burner a des ennuis avec le fils d'un élu local, tandis que Spoon tombe amoureux de la fiancée de son père.

Au cours de sa traversée psychédélique, elle assiste à un meurtre d'une cruauté surprenante. Persuadée que cet assassinat n'est pas que le fruit de son imagination, elle se met en quête de l'assassin.

programme.title: Wicked City
programme.desc: Dans un monde où humains et démons coexistent secrètement, une unité spéciale veille à maintenir la paix entre les deux espèces. Taki, un agent humain, et Makie, une envoûtante femme-démon, sont chargés de protéger un diplomate clé lors de négociations cruciales.

programme.title: L'Œil du Labyrinthe

Lorsque des meurtres mystérieux commencent à frapper les membres de la famille, la malédiction semble devenir réalité… Mais où s'arrête la légende, et où commence la manipulation ?

programme.title: Michelle Keegan On Imposter Syndrome, Boundaries, And Puzzles
programme.desc: Imposter syndrome is likely to affect all of us at some point in our life Michelle Keegan still feels it every time she finishes an acting job. In this chat with Fearne, Michelle talks about her disciplined work ethic, as well as how she's learnt to cope well with the amount of rejection in her industry. They also chat about why setting boundaries – especially drawing lines between personal and professional life – is so important. Plus, they wonder why it still feels important in adulthood to seek validation from our parents.

programme.title: Monty Don: Why Doing Nothing Isn't How He Switches Off
programme.desc: What does a truly restful holiday look like? Horticulturalist Monty Don relaxes most when he knows the drill: same Greek island, same terrace for breakfast, same collapsible travel kettle packed. In this chat with Fearne, Monty explains the difference between all the globe-trotting he does for work and a proper switching-off holiday. They discuss the excitement of stepping off a plane into an entirely different culture, as well as why you won't find either of them staying up late for a social dinner.

programme.title: Miquita Oliver: "I Thought I Hated You Fearne"
programme.desc: Back in the noughties, Miquita Oliver thought Fearne Cotton was an irritatingly gorgeous, successful presenter - everything she wasn't. Fearne was jealous Miquita was part of the TV cool gang. In reality, Fearne worried she was an unsophisticated nerd, while Miquita was feeling like the fat, ugly sidekick. Live from the Happy Place Festival.

programme.title: Matt Edmondson & Mollie King On Imposter Syndrome & Finding Your Voice
programme.desc: Fearne Cotton talks with Radio 1 presenters Matt Edmondson and Mollie King about self-doubt, imposter syndrome, and the power of supportive friendships. From Mollie's memories of struggling to read out loud at school to Matt's experience of feeling like an imposter when he first joined Radio 1, they explore the inner critic so many of us live with.

programme.title: Julian Clary On Easing Anxiety
programme.desc: Can laughter ease anxiety? Comedian Julian Clary certainly thinks so. After living some incredibly dark events and anxious times, he's decided to choose to laugh and think positive thoughts. In this chat with Fearne, Julian talks about feeling naturally happier and more comfortable in his skin as he got older. Most things, he says, just aren't as important as you think they are, and that's a freeing realisation.

programme.title: Louise Redknapp On Coping With Loneliness And Low Self-Esteem
programme.desc: Singer Louise Redknapp discusses feeling pressure to be the 'good girl' after years in a 90s girlband and marriage to a sports star, which left her afraid of saying or doing the wrong thing. She explores how not knowing her dad and becoming a mother have impacted her confidence and identity, and shares how she's learning to trust her own gut instinct and embrace different facets of her character.

programme.title: Kate Winslet: Why I'm Embracing Wrinkles And Championing Women
programme.desc: Grief can make you feel unnervingly vulnerable this is how Kate Winslet reflects on losing her mum in 2017. In this chat, Fearne and Kate share their own experiences of both grieving and co-parenting at Christmas. Regularly labelled as "fat" by the media, Kate explains what effect that scrutiny had on her self-esteem, and why it's made her even more passionate about setting an example to younger women by ageing naturally.

programme.title: Jesy Nelson On Finding Herself And Feeling Free After Leaving Little Mix
programme.desc: As part of Little Mix, Jesy Nelson felt constantly compared to her bandmates and struggled with the pressure of being in a girl band, leading to self-esteem problems and depression. She discusses with Fearne how appearance mattered as much as talent in the music industry.

programme.title: Swamp Bride
programme.desc: What is David Tutera to do with a bride who is allergic to flowers and wants her wedding décor to resemble a swamp? This is a first for David, and with only three weeks until the wedding, he's going to either sink or swim. His first challenge is to get his head strong bride to agree to change out her wedding gown. Not easy. And as for the bridesmaid's dresses that look like lily pads? Oh yes, they are second to go! Since David's bride has such a unique vision for her big day, he's on a quest for one-of-a-kind wedding favors. Favors that have to include frogs – yes, frogs. And finally, it's time to face the challenge of what food to serve at this wedding, so what better than a yummy food tasting. And when the big day finally arrives, our bride has all of Manhattan as a backdrop and fireworks to finalize a magical day.

programme.title: Diva Bride
programme.desc: They say everything is bigger in Texas, and so is the personality of David Tutera's new Dallas bride. When she says “diva”, you better say ‘licious” , because she's a force to be reckoned with. How do you combine Lady Gaga, Beyonce, Mardi Gras and pink feathers into a wedding? With three weeks until the big day, David decides to make everything off the charts! Glittery, glamorous reception dresses for not only the bride but the bridesmaids as well. And nothing says “diva” like an over-the-top photo shoot! And what better location for this production, than a theater complete with a red carpet entrance!

programme.title: Cowgirl Bride
programme.desc: With many brides, the dress is the most important thing for her wedding. But with David Tutera's next bride – it's all about the cowboy boots! This Texas cowgirl is dead set on two stepping her way into the sunset, and David is determined to have her step into a pair of nice heels! The challenges start with giving the bride a sophisticated gown to wear – with or without boots! And speaking of boots, how about bridal boot camp to get into shape for the big day? A picture-perfect Texas ranch transforms into the ideal setting for our country bride to dance the night away under the stars.

programme.title: Pirate Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera has planned plenty of destination weddings, so when he heard about a Caribbean wedding, the last thing he thought it would be was, “pirates of the Caribbean”! David's latest bride, Brooke Lewis loves the idea of pirates, but instead of planning an elegant wedding, it's turning into a 5-year-olds birthday party! So her décor and venue are the first to go when David takes over the planning. Brooke gets a beautiful and romantic wedding gown, and the bridesmaids are decked out in jewel-toned dresses. And since this bride is a true treasure, she needs to wear stunning jewels – how about $250,000 worth? And just when she thinks the surprises are done, David takes her on a little climbing expedition. Something that will make her trust her wedding planner as well as letting off a little steam.

programme.title: Butterfly Bride
programme.desc: Where does David Tutera begin with a bride who wants butterflies, rainbows, butterflies and then more butterflies? Monique Villegas is a sweet bride who loves colors and whimsy but has no idea how to pull off a wedding. With only 3 weeks before her big day, David takes charge, and the magic begins. Rainbows are captured in the Swarovski crystal jewelry that our bride tries on. And how about a champagne toast at sunset in a private jet, flying high above Los Angeles to make a brides dreams come true?

programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: H2O
programme.sub-title: Just add Water, Season 2: S02 E10 Missed the Boat
programme.desc: Cleo is failing at school. Lewis waits for Cleo to ask him for help, giving Charlotte an idea - she volunteers to help tutor Cleo! Cleo is horrified but is forced by Don to accept. Charlotte takes the opportunity to set Cleo mountains of homework keeping Cleo busy so she can have Lewis all to herself. Charlotte pressures Lewis to take her to Mako Island so she can sketch some landscapes.

programme.title: H2O
programme.sub-title: Just add Water, Season 2: S02 E11 In Over Our Heads
programme.desc: Zane hears of treasure under the ocean and enlists Rikki to help find it, after all a mermaid can search the bottom of the ocean pretty fast. Rikki is reluctant until she discovers her dad is having trouble paying the bills - and they might be forced to move. Rikki gets Emma and Cleo to help, but conceals her true reasons for wanting the treasure.

programme.title: H2O
programme.sub-title: Just add Water, Season 2: S02 E12 Fish Fever
programme.desc: Emma starts acting very weird after pricking her finger on a mysterious barb of coral, suddenly becoming ravenous for things like anchovy flavoured fish food! Cleo's fish, Hector, exhibits the same behaviour. As Hector begins to look very sick, Emma turns into a mermaid at the marine park, swimming about in front of the glass in the viewing area.

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: More and more plastic bags are polluting Dolphin City Bay, and the turtles mistake the bags for sea-sponges and suffocate on them. Our three mermaids, alerted by their friend Teddy the turtle, tackle the problem. After some unsuccessful attempts, they and Lewis decide to use stronger methods to stir up public opinion.

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a violent storm, Dolphin City looks like a new Bermuda Triangle: boats mysteriously break down or sink in the bay. At the sight of hordes of journalists, the girls investigate, with Lewis' help. They find out that a lightning bolt from the storm has activated mysterious crystals whose magnetic field disrupts navigation equipment.

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: When Emma, Cleo and Rikki find out two superstars – Brad Patinson and Scarlett Belladonna - are shooting a film in Dolphin City, directed by the famous Martin Fabiola, they try anything to get on the set. Luckily Zane has been hired by the production! Only Rikki prefers to approach the stars in her own way – underwater of course!

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: Murray and Burke are inconsolable: their pal Danny the octopus has disappeared! By chance, Cleo finds out that he's in fact been captured by the Oceanic Center, who are conducting scientific research. Murray puts pressure on the mermaids to get Danny out of there and bring him back to the sea. But Danny doesn't want to go home.

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: Why has a whale calf run aground on an isolated beach near Dolphin City? And what's causing the girls' migraines? Does it have anything to do with the dolphin twins' bizarre sickness? During their investigations the mermaids come across a strange fishing boat using illegal technology: an extremely low-frequency military radar device.

programme.title: H2O
programme.desc: Burke the hammerhead shark has broken a tooth. To sooth the pain, he has to come up for air at the surface regularly: but in so doing, he involuntarily shows his fin. Before long a panic wave runs through the citizens of Dolphin City, who think they've got a dangerous shark on their hands.

programme.title: H2O
programme.sub-title: Just add Water, Season 3: S03 E07 Happy Families
programme.desc: A problematic family beach picnic leads Don to end his relationship with Samantha until Cleo encourages him to pursue it.

programme.desc: Rikki and Bella hide out at Cleo's to protect themselves from a full moon water attack. Bella's kidnapped by a water tentacle and taken to Mako Island.

programme.title: H2O
programme.sub-title: Just add Water, Season 3: S03 E09 The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programme.desc: Cleo defies Lewis' advice and experiments with the magic Moon Pool water. Using her powers, Rikki accidentally gets the water into Cleo's aquarium.

programme.title: H2O
programme.sub-title: Just add Water, Season 3: S03 E10 Revealed
programme.desc: Bella's warned to back off from Will as he's on the trail of the girls' mermaid secrets. She gets too close to him and he finally discovers she's a mermaid.

programme.title: H2O
programme.sub-title: Just add Water, Season 3: S03 E11 Just a Girl at Heart
programme.desc: Bella helps Will with his free-diving training but when she realises he's more interested in her as a mermaid than a girl, she's hurt.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.13
programme.desc: During a dinner together, Inhyuk offers his congratulations to Euna and her fiancé, but an unmistakable tension lingers between the two men. Meanwhile, the ER is flooded with patients stung by jellyfish after a seaside outing—only to be thrown into further chaos when three men and women arrive with shotgun wounds.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.14
programme.desc: As Minwoo and Jaein clash over opposing views on amputating Wonguk's leg, the announcement of support for a new trauma center further clouds the decision on whether to proceed with surgery. Meanwhile, Minwoo struggles to understand Jaein's unusually sympathetic approach toward the kidnapper Yoo Seung-cheol.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.15
programme.desc: Though Wonguk's leg amputation is successfully completed and the team breathes a collective sigh of relief, Minwoo is left conflicted as he gazes at the severed limb. Watching Euna hand over her duties and prepare to leave for Canada, Inhyuk is overcome with memories from the past.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.16
programme.desc: When Daeje, suffering from severe headaches and unable to even stand, is rushed into the ER, tension grips the hospital. Unaware that Jaein is Daeje's granddaughter, Minwoo stays by her side, watching over a visibly shaken and distraught Jaein.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.17
programme.desc: The hospital staff soon learns the shocking truth—that Jaein is the chairman's granddaughter. At the same time, an emergency audit is launched by the Ministry of Health and Welfare. With Daeje still unconscious, calls rise to convene a board meeting to determine who will lead the hospital in his absence, leaving Geumnyeo deep in deliberation.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.18
programme.desc: With only interns left staffing the emergency room, a pregnant woman involved in a traffic accident is rushed in after going into cardiac arrest, leaving the interns paralyzed by a life-or-death decision. Meanwhile, as Daeje remains unconscious, a board meeting is convened to discuss the appointment of an interim chairperson.

programme.title: I Can Hear Your Voice Ep.2
programme.desc: Hye-sung barely makes the cut as the public defender for Yeon-ju city and gets published in the newspaper. Soo-ha finally gets to meet Hye-sung after 10 years.

programme.title: I Can Hear Your Voice Ep.3
programme.desc: Hye-sung trusts Soo-ha's and goes for the not guilty verdict during her first trial. Soo-ha helps Hae-sung with her trial by sending her signals during the hearing.

programme.title: I Can Hear Your Voice Ep.4
programme.desc: Soo-ha finds out that Min Joon-guk is trying to hurt Hye-sung. He tries to notify the police but the police can't help him due to lack of evidence.

programme.title: I Can Hear Your Voice Ep.5
programme.desc: Hye-sung realizes that the kid that she met during a trial 10 years ago was Soo-ha. She realizes that he wants to protect her…

programme.title: I Can Hear Your Voice Ep.6
programme.desc: Hye-sung finds out the truth about the twins with Soo-ha's help. In order to find the truth, Hye-sung accepts a dangerous offer from Do-yeon.

programme.title: I Can Hear Your Voice Ep.7
programme.desc: Hye-sung's mom had a dream that Hye-sung was drowning. Her dreams have always been spot on, and it bothers Hye-sung…

programme.title: My Troublesome Star Ep.6
programme.desc: Actress Im Se Ra (Jang Da A) is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.desc: Young Chun stabs Tae Gu during custody. Ha Young studies him closely, but his arrogance and twisted psyche disgust him even more.

programme.title: Through the Darkness Ep.9
programme.desc: After four years, the team earns recognition. Detectives learn profiling from Ha Young, but Young Soo worries Ha Young is becoming like the killers he studies.

programme.title: Through the Darkness Ep.10
programme.desc: Ha Young questions Ki Tae and is horrified by his brutal details. Police cannot find the murder weapon, a key to convict him.

programme.title: Through the Darkness Ep.11
programme.desc: Ha Young burns out from serial murder cases and quits. But new missing cases emerge, and Dae Woong asks him to return for help.

programme.title: Through the Darkness Ep.12
programme.desc: A suspect in missing women cases resists interrogation. Ha Young spots his weakness and uses new tactics, eventually breaking him down.

programme.title: Through the Darkness Ep.1
programme.desc: A woman is killed in Daebong-dong. While others follow evidence, Ha Young seeks the killer's motive. Young Soo sees his talent and proposes a behavioral team.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.23
programme.desc: Upon returning to the palace, Gwanghae insists that the letter King Seonjo presents to him has been forged—but the king refuses to believe it. Jeongi is shaken when Imhae warns her that anyone tied to the alleged treason will not escape unscathed. When Jeongi meets Gwanghae, she vows to restrain even her own feelings so as not to become a burden to him. Court Lady Gukbi is stunned to learn that Jeongi is Yeonok's daughter.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.24
programme.desc: After uncovering the full truth, Jeongi begins searching for a way to bring about Gangcheon's downfall, with Taedo pledging to help her. When Jeongi and Gwanghae cross paths at the Bunwon, they share a tender, wordless gaze filled with longing. Upon discovering a ledger detailing Gangcheon's bribes, Jeongi resolves to win Royal Consort Inbin's favor. Meanwhile, Hwa-ryeong decides to eliminate Son Haengsu.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.25
programme.desc: Leaving her audience with Inbin, Jeongi runs into Gangcheon and Yukdo at the palace. When King Seonjo refers to Euldam as a traitor, Jeongi is left on edge. Together with Taedo, she devises a plan to ensnare Gangcheon. Later, Gwanghae returns the bowl Jeongi once gave to Son Haengsu. Impressed by Jeongi's skill, Inbin requests that if Jeongi crafts a medicine bowl that fully satisfies Prince Shinseong, she be officially appointed a master potter.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.26
programme.desc: As Jeongi and Yukdo face off in a decisive competition, all eyes at the Bunwon are fixed on the outcome. Thrilled at the prospect of becoming nangcheong, Yukdo is confident of victory. Jeongi asks Hwa-ryeong to procure the white clay needed for the contest, while Hwa-ryeong urges Yukdo to defeat Jeongi at all costs. When the medicine bowls are completed, Jeongi and Yukdo anxiously await Prince Shinseong's judgment—until the prince suddenly collapses after drinking from the bowl.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.27
programme.desc: Jeongi confronts Gangcheon, demanding that he reveal the truth about Euldam, but his shameless willingness to offer a false confession only fuels her anger. Gwanghae vows before King Seonjo to uncover not only the truth behind the current 사건 but also the events of the previous nangcheong competition. A royal order is issued for Yukdo's execution, and a grief-stricken Gangcheon kneels before the palace gates in penitence.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.28
programme.desc: Mun Saseung is appointed as the new nangcheong of the Bunwon, and Jeongi becomes the first female master potter in Joseon history. Seeing Jeongi clad in her official potter's robes, Gwanghae smiles with pride and gifts her the workshop once used by Euldam. Reduced to desperation, Gangcheon and Yukdo beg Mun Saseung to allow them to remain at the Bunwon. Elsewhere, at the request of a Japanese merchant, Hwa-ryeong summons Jeongi—hinting at new trials yet to come.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth

A true celebration of nature's wonders and a powerful reminder of the importance of preserving our planet's delicate balance.

programme.title: Rottnest Island: Kingdom Of The Quokka
programme.desc: Islands worldwide are grand experiments in nature, with their isolation creating unique conditions for animals to diverge from the norm. On the far west of the Australian continent lies Rottnest Island where one of the worlds ‘happiest', yet most vulnerable marsupials the Quokka thrives. How do they survive here in such inhospitable conditions and nowhere else? In a world first, the entire life cycle of the Quokka will be filmed using special natural history filming techniques to expose the secrets of its survival mechanisms.

programme.title: Time Flies
programme.desc: We like to think we can control everything: changing the course of water, reclaiming land, replanting deserts – we constantly remodel the natural world to suit our needs. But there's one thing we can't control: the passing of time. However, we can change how we see things using cameras we can start to see the world in different time frames. Now we can see animals following the sun, mass movements of the changing seasons and even the vast impact of the changing weather. Watch what happens when time flies…

programme.title: Bucketlist Australia
programme.desc: If Australia makes you think of beaches and BBQs, cricket and cork hats, you haven't seen anything yet. Giant deserts, ancient rainforest, tropical coasts and mystical rock formations. And not forgetting some of the weirdest and most wonderful animals on the planet. From iconic kangaroos and emus to the fearsome cassowary and cuddly koalas, you can find creatures here that you'll find nowhere else on the planet. There's only one place where you can find all these bucket list encounters – Australia!

programme.title: Bucketlist South America
programme.desc: One of the biggest continents crammed with adventures and possibilities, South America should be up there on any wildlife watcher's bucket list. From record breaking rivers and longest mountain ranges to the steepest waterfalls and most massive rainforests, the variety of landscapes supports a seemingly endless diversity of wildlife. Here you can find the biggest rodents, otters and parrots, with unique mammals and marine life and spectacular predators. Make sure you don't miss South America!

programme.title: The most spectacular change of seasons
programme.desc: This film explores Central Europe and presents the nature from a perspective you have never seen before. Fascinating landscape footage in high-quality HD technology, coupled with spectacular Cineflex aerial views, take us on a journey through the hitherto unknown blazes of colour of the Central European region and its inhabitants. We show you paradise on earth and demonstrate how climate and astronomy determine our life cycle. While seasons change, we visit several different European habitats that - in their diversity, are exemplary of a Central European region. Mountains, water, forests and meadows: we return to each of these habitats at different times of the year and show how the rhythm of life of each of our protagonists follows nature's clock. The four seasons determine all of the coming and passing away a highly complex interplay in the universe of life. We explore the wondrous worlds of the mysterious cycle of nature together with extraordinary people. Breathtaking landscapes enable us to experience the change of seasons at first hand.

programme.title: The Sun
programme.desc: On July 23rd, 2012, a massive eruption on the sun hurls a colossal cloud of solar matter into space. It's the most severe sunstorm in 150 years. Fortunately, the Earth is not in the direct path of this solar ejection. But it's only a matter of time before a violent solar storm hits us. When these clouds of charged matter reach our planet, they can wreak havoc in electrical systems.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life's element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Europe's far North
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

With the help of her friends, Stephanie is set on running a clean campaign -- that is, until Tanya resorts to more dirty tricks, and Stephanie decides to give Tanya a taste of her own medicine.

programme.title: The Grateful Dud
programme.desc: At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a teen bulldozer named Fiona. But when Fiona's pushy, over-the-top appreciation makes Mia's life a living nightmare, the Friends must Ride To The Rescue! At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: Masha's Songs

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This tale tells us about one Caliph from the East, who used to sit all day long in front of the window and listen to the birds chirping. Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds' language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a boy called Jack. He was so poor that no girl would want to marry him. One day he went to the market to sell the cow and buy himself a suit. On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This fairy tale is about one little and witty tailor, who had a chance to defeat the giant and obtain a fridge full of sweets. So he ate all of them at once. Then he decided to get out on the street, but could not, as he overate and got stuck in the door. This story teaches us a vital lesson not to be greedy and eat too much otherwise we might get into a messy situation.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Masha tells her version of the fairy tale about the poor girl called Cinderella. She lived with her stepmother who forced her to work till dawn. One day the stepmother asked Cinderella to crack three bags of nuts. The poor girl would never have managed to complete this task, if only the fairy had appeared in front of her. By magic, the fairy emerged and conjured her Nutcracker, who helped Cinderella to crack all the nuts very fast. The Cinderella was so happy that she took the Nutcracker with her to the ball, which took place in the royal palace. The Nutcracker helped the King to save the palace from rats and Cinderella was so thankful that she kissed him in his cheek. In this very moment the Nutcracker turned into a handsome prince! The moral of the story is that we should not judge the others by their appearance.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Reverend Dwight Moore is at death's door when he is transferred from his local hospital to Memorial Hospital in Chapel Hill. With all the expertise and technology of modern medicine at their disposal, doctors are still unable to find of the cause of Moore's symptoms, which include stomach pain, numbness, and hallucinations. His devoted wife Blanche remains by his side throughout his puzzling illness. She tries to comfort him by bringing his favorite banana pudding from home. When Moore's vital functions begin to shut down, a visiting specialist examines him and notices white striation lines on his fingernails, an indication of arsenic poisoning. Tests reveal that Moore has ingested more arsenic than any living person on record. Police investigators question him about his wife and discover that Blanche Moore's two previous husbands both met untimely deaths. Their bodies are exhumed and found to contain high levels of arsenic, and Blanche Moore is convicted of murder and sentenced to death.
